notes: Designer-synthesized machine-readable projection of the print-plan/interface declaration provided directly in this commission's dispatch prompt (no separately-dispatched print-engineer print_plan.md exists on disk for this job at this revision -- the commission text itself states 'treat as the accepted plan'). All numeric bands below are copied verbatim from that dispatch text, not designer-chosen. Per broom-step2-reference/reference_manifest.md, the upstream dimensions.md is still status=DRAFT and its own 'Reference round trip' table is still PENDING (no metrologist/photo overlay verdict yet) -- this print-plan-checks file and the candidate it gates do not resolve that upstream gate; they proceed on the commission's explicit instruction to treat the given interface declaration as accepted for this design round.

model_to_printer_transform.bed_contact_landmark: ring bottom rim (Z=0) + mounting-flange bottom face (Z=0)
model_to_printer_transform.note: IDENTITY -- clip.stl IS the print-frame STL. Ring axis is modeled along +Z; every print layer is a complete horizontal C-shaped slice (support-free for the ring itself). Mouth opens toward +X, i.e. LATERAL in the print's horizontal plane, matching the plan's 'prefer support-free (the C-opening lateral)' guidance.

geometry_rules.final_gate: verifier rejects any candidate whose re-imported-STL wall thickness falls under 1.2mm

geometry_rules.requirement: a flat mounting-back face suitable to be screwed or stuck to a wall
geometry_rules.source: commission print-plan text: 'A mounting back (flat face) so it can be screwed/stuck to a wall; keep it simple.'

edges.description: Exposed hand-contact comfort edges: the 4 fin-tip/mouth corner edges (OD+ID x 2 tips), the top rim (OD+ID) of the partial-wrap ring, and the mounting flange's own outer vertical perimeter corners -- all touched during snap-on/off and installation.
Bed-contact perimeter chamfer (Z=0): ring bottom OD/ID rim + tip bottoms + mounting-flange bottom perimeter, for elephant-foot immunity.

support_rules.note: Small nonzero budget (not 0) is deliberate, not a loosened gate for convenience: the E-02 bed-contact 45deg chamfer's own faces sit exactly at this screen's -0.7071 (45deg) classification threshold -- the same borderline-classification artifact documented in tests/eval/pixel-step4-design/candidate_readiness.md for its G-04 rim chamfer. This is an intended, plan-required feature (not a support region), so a small tolerance for that edge case is budgeted up front rather than discovered and rationalized after a FAIL. See candidate_readiness.md for the actual measured area and its breakdown.

interfaces.motion_path: radial snap through the open mouth (~150deg opening); rod approaches along -X toward the concentric/seated position at the ring's own axis
interfaces.material: PETG clip on a Ø30.0mm round rod (generic/wood broom handle per tests/eval/broom-step2-reference)
interfaces.acceptance_method: grips a Ø30mm rod without slipping under the rod's own/light lateral load; releases by a deliberate hand pull -- per commission text, not a printed-coupon gauge-pin test this round
